body: D1 admitted with 5/5 pins verified as partial independent equation/arithmetic checks. Its buckling and wrinkling margins differ from the owner's co-binding values, but it uses one ISA pressure for both weather labels and names missing pressure, Vc and fuller bill terms. Reconcile equations/load cases and omitted terms before calling those margins corrected. No replacement optimized targets are supplied. The 39 pairs, modulus closures and gamma/Q caps were not independently reoptimized; the 0.514 check divides stored slopes. Density targets remain model witnesses, not independently established optima. D1/D2 local-index ratios use different reference moduli, 293.6 versus 290 GPa. Both review halves are filed; preserve these limits in the delta. No extra round requested; 068 remains independent.
